steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hahahaha! What kind of trash is Ambrosia? This is more like it! This is the hardship and pain I want!

steps.speaker: *Pant*...
steps.content: This is what makes victory sweet!
She laughs gleefully. The Sacred Sword in her hand shatters along with the dream, dissolving into dark smoke. From the smoke, you hear strange sounds.

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: Are you crying? You dare cry? Shut your mouth!

steps.speaker: Chaotic Voices
steps.content: You useless, good-for-nothing imbecile! You shouldn't have been born!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What's wrong with you? Why do you look so stunned? Are you shocked by my true strength?

steps.speaker: I can't lead them to where there are people... That would only get innocent people killed!!
steps.content: Haha, isn't this kind of malice awesome? Don't I look dashing when fighting with it?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Even though it's a fake Dreadlord, it still feels satisfying enough. Come, let's celebrate! Let's take a selfie together.
The whispers from the smoke still pester her, but the girl flashes you a wide, odd and bright smile. Intrigued by the darkness, she coexists with the filth as if it's nothing.
Maybe she just wants to keep walking into the abyss alone after all of this is over...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Mess, come with me after you wake up.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Why so cheesy all of a sudden? Didn't you just lie to me, bully me, and attack me for your own motives? I still remember how much you tricked me in the dream!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That was the past. Let's look to the future.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I like the swords you forge, and I like your courage.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come with me, little Hero. Let's go fight the Great Dreadlord together.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Hmph. So you didn't bully me on purpose. I thought you were a wolf in sheep's clothing. I wanted to uncover your evil intentions, but you turned out to be a goody two-shoes. How disappointing.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sorry, I am just a goody two-shoes.
I mean, I guess I can be bad if you want me to.

steps.content: She makes an exaggerated vomiting expression, thinks for a moment, then giggles.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: But I liked the dream with you. Even though you're a goody two-shoes, you're the most fun goody two-shoes.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's go. The dream's over. Back to our world.

steps.content: You stretch out your hand to Mess, who is surrounded by black smoke. She smiles and walks toward you...
Then, she suddenly stumbles.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Mmm! You are?
Radiant, transparent liquid seeps out from the cracks in the space, quickly soaking and ensnaring Mess's body. It's Ambrosia?!
A hand covers Mess's mouth from behind. A figure walks out from behind Mess, who passes out before getting a chance to struggle.
After the dream has shattered, you regain the power of the shackles. Your shackles shoot out towards the two, but instantly get dispelled upon touching the Ambrosia.
The figure becomes clearer, grasping the unconscious Mess from behind. To your shock, it's that soulless hallucination!

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: It wasn't easy for my friend to get here and find her sweet dreams. Could you... please leave us alone?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: The dream has already ended. Why are you still...
Who are you? How come you can defy her will?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Good evening, my dear. I'm the one who helped her create her dream. I'm the one who gave her happiness...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mess doesn't need false dreams. Her courage and strength lie in the real world. She yearns to face reality!

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Ha. How much of her reality do you know of to make this decision for her?

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content:
O dreamless one... You've never tasted a sweet dream, so you assume that no one else wants it, either...
You only have reality in your grasp, so you assert that everyone needs reality...

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: You truly are arrogant and cruel.
The ground beneath your feet suddenly splinters, and a huge force expels you from this world...

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Go back! If you don't want to stay, then never come back! Don't ruin the beautiful dreams I created for them!
